name: shinchantw_cbt_main_stage_bottleneck_20260729_155740_074669
sql:
/*
主线关卡漏斗与卡点。通过率为代理指标：玩家在所选周期内挑战过更高主线关，视为已通过当前关。
没有明确胜负字段时，不能将重复挑战直接等同“失败”。
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
MainStageAttempts AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT),
            TRY_CAST(v.stage_id AS BIGINT)
        ) AS stage_id,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(v.role_lev AS BIGINT)) AS role_level,
        COUNT(*) AS attempt_times
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON v."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
UserMaxStage AS (
    SELECT account_id, MAX(stage_id) AS max_stage_id
    FROM MainStageAttempts
    WHERE stage_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
StageAgg AS (
    SELECT
        a.stage_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS challenge_users,
        SUM(a.attempt_times) AS challenge_times,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.max_stage_id > a.stage_id THEN a.account_id END) AS inferred_pass_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.max_stage_id = a.stage_id AND a.attempt_times >= 2 THEN a.account_id END) AS bottleneck_users,
        AVG(CASE WHEN m.max_stage_id = a.stage_id AND a.attempt_times >= 2 THEN CAST(a.role_level AS DOUBLE) END) AS bottleneck_avg_level,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(CASE WHEN m.max_stage_id = a.stage_id AND a.attempt_times >= 2 THEN a.role_level END, 0.5) AS bottleneck_median_level
    FROM MainStageAttempts a
    INNER JOIN UserMaxStage m ON a.account_id = m.account_id
    WHERE a.stage_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(d."stage_id@stage_name_show", CAST(s.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) AS "关卡名称",
    s.stage_id AS "关卡ID",
    s.challenge_users AS "挑战人数",
    s.challenge_times AS "挑战次数",
    ROUND(s.challenge_times * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.challenge_users, 0), 2) AS "人均挑战次数",
    s.inferred_pass_users AS "推断通过人数",
    ROUND(s.inferred_pass_users * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.challenge_users, 0), 2) AS "推断通过率(%)",
    s.bottleneck_users AS "卡点人数(最高关且重试≥2)",
    ROUND(s.bottleneck_users * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.challenge_users, 0), 2) AS "卡点率(%)",
    ROUND(s.bottleneck_avg_level, 1) AS "卡点平均等级",
    s.bottleneck_median_level AS "卡点等级中位数"
FROM StageAgg s
LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765 d ON s.stage_id = d."stage_id@stage_id"
ORDER BY "卡点人数(最高关且重试≥2)" DESC, "挑战人数" DESC;
